subject.title: Fullerton Joint Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: As a District leader, I have consistently championed a place where every student is important -with a choice among schools and programs, an education relevant to the future, and a safe and supportive environment.
My experience on the board as a strong, ethical and fiscally responsible leader has equipped me to protect the extraordinary quality of our schools.
Students in the Fullerton Joint Union High School District are attending, graduating and excelling in record numbers as they prepare for transition to college and career.

Our district, with the financial support of our communities, has completed such major improvements as science labs, theaters and gyms. Our teachers, support staff and leadership personnel are among the best.

My experience at the state level broadens my knowledge and ultimately helps to improve our award-winning schools. I serve on the policy-making body and as a past president of a statewide educational organization (CSBA) dedicated to sound governance standards for school board members.

As a long-time resident of the community, parent of district graduates, PTA leader and community volunteer, I am committed to making sure that our schools deliver the exceptional education that our community demands.

text: As a South Korean immigrant adopted at eight months old, I came to America to live the American dream. That dream has always been to help others. In earning a Human Services degree from Cal State Fullerton I strengthened my commitment to serving others in our community.
Now is the time to pass the baton of leadership in Area 5.
Being a connected parent and volunteer, I listen to families and am committed to ensuring our students’ needs are met.
As a mother of two Fullerton public school students, PTA leader, and 15-year resident, I am deeply committed to our schools and community and understand the needs of today’s students and families.

Through serving on School Site Council, I have worked alongside students, teachers, and families. As a trustee, I will support teachers, expand student opportunities by preparing them for college or the workforce, ensure our schools remain safe, and advocate for access to the mental health resources students need to thrive.

Serving my community is both a privilege and a responsibility. I ask for your vote and support as we unite to build a stronger FJUHSD -one where every student has the opportunity to succeed and reach their full potential.
